cat /etc/redis-old/redis.conf | grep -v '^#' | grep -v '^$'; echo ----; grep -v '^#' /etc/valkey/valkey.conf | grep -v '^$'; ls /opt/redis-7.2/bin; which valkey-cli redis-cli

C=/opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli; $C -p 6379 info server | head -5; $C -p 6379 info keyspace; $C -p 6379 info replication; $C -p 6379 config get rename*; $C -p 6379 acl list; $C -p 6379 module list; valkey-cli -p 6380 info server | head -5; valkey-cli -p 6380 info keyspace; valkey-cli -p 6380 info replication; valkey-cli -p 6380 config get databases; $C -p 6379 config get databases
valkey-cli -p 6380 replicaof 127.0.0.1 6379; sleep 3; valkey-cli -p 6380 info replication | head -12; valkey-cli -p 6380 info keyspace; tail -20 /var/log/valkey/valkey.log

C=/opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli; $C -p 6379 info replication | grep -E 'offset|slave0'; valkey-cli -p 6380 info replication | grep -E 'offset|link'; $C -p 6379 info keyspace; valkey-cli -p 6380 info keyspace

valkey-cli -p 6380 replicaof no one; valkey-cli -p 6380 info replication | head -3; valkey-cli -p 6380 config get replica-read-only; grep -i replicaof /etc/valkey/valkey.conf; valkey-cli -p 6380 set __migration_writetest 1 && valkey-cli -p 6380 del __migration_writetest

cat > /tmp/verify.py <<'EOF'
import redis
diff=0; n=0
for db in range(16):
    a=redis.Redis(port=6379,db=db); b=redis.Redis(port=6380,db=db)
    ka=set(a.scan_iter(count=1000)); kb=set(b.scan_iter(count=1000))
    if ka!=kb: print("db",db,"keyset diff",len(ka-kb),len(kb-ka)); diff+=1
    for k in ka:
        n+=1
        t=a.type(k)
        if t!=b.type(k): print("type",db,k); diff+=1; continue
        t=t.decode()
        if t=='string': va,vb=a.get(k),b.get(k)
        elif t=='list': va,vb=a.lrange(k,0,-1),b.lrange(k,0,-1)
        elif t=='set': va,vb=a.smembers(k),b.smembers(k)
        elif t=='zset': va,vb=a.zrange(k,0,-1,withscores=True),b.zrange(k,0,-1,withscores=True)
        elif t=='hash': va,vb=a.hgetall(k),b.hgetall(k)
        elif t=='stream':
            va=(a.xrange(k),[ (g, a.xinfo_consumers(k,g['name'])) for g in a.xinfo_groups(k)], a.xpending_range(k,'-','+',10**6) if False else None)
            vb=(b.xrange(k),[ (g, b.xinfo_consumers(k,g['name'])) for g in b.xinfo_groups(k)], None)
            ga=[(g['name'],g['last-delivered-id'],g['pending'],g.get('entries-read')) for g in a.xinfo_groups(k)]
            gb=[(g['name'],g['last-delivered-id'],g['pending'],g.get('entries-read')) for g in b.xinfo_groups(k)]
            pa=[[ (p['message_id'],p['consumer'],p['times_delivered']) for p in a.xpending_range(k,g[0],'-','+',100000)] for g in ga]
            pb=[[ (p['message_id'],p['consumer'],p['times_delivered']) for p in b.xpending_range(k,g[0],'-','+',100000)] for g in gb]
            ia=a.execute_command('XINFO','STREAM',k); ib=b.execute_command('XINFO','STREAM',k)
            va=(a.xrange(k),ga,pa,ia.get(b'last-generated-id') if isinstance(ia,dict) else ia[ia.index(b'last-generated-id')+1])
            vb=(b.xrange(k),gb,pb,ib.get(b'last-generated-id') if isinstance(ib,dict) else ib[ib.index(b'last-generated-id')+1])
        else: print("other type",t,k); va,vb=a.dump(k),b.dump(k)
        if va!=vb: print("value",db,k,t); diff+=1
        ta,tb=a.pexpiretime(k),b.pexpiretime(k)
        if ta!=tb: print("ttl",db,k,ta,tb); diff+=1
print("keys",n,"diffs",diff)
EOF
python3 /tmp/verify.py
valkey-cli -p 6380 bgsave; sleep 2; valkey-cli -p 6380 info persistence | grep -E 'bgsave_status|rdb_changes'; /opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 info replication | head -3
